candidate.answerReason: Every figure in group A has half-turn symmetry. Groups B and C contain triangles or a regular pentagon, which lack central symmetry.

methods.label: Identify figures with half-turn symmetry
methods.explanation: A parallelogram, a rectangle, and a circle each coincide with themselves after a \(180^\circ\) rotation about their center of symmetry. Equilateral triangles, isosceles triangles, and regular pentagons are not centrally symmetric figures.
methods.levelReason: This is a direct Grade 9 application of the definition of a centrally symmetric figure.

candidate.annotationRationale:
